target.statement: AUROC of RiForest on the Glass dataset (0.7086)

compute.basis: No code released; must implement RiForest from Algorithm 1 and run 20 repetitions on Glass (214 samples, 9 features) with 100 trees, subsample 256, plus data download and environment setup.

blockers: No code or hyperparameter details beyond the paper; implementation from scratch required
Exact reproduction of the 20-run average may be sensitive to random seeds and implementation details
title: Robust Isolation Forest using Soft Sparse Random Projection and Valley Emphasis Method
